global.title: UK awards ClearSpace $80 million prime contract for dual-satellite deorbit mission
global.summary: TAMPA, Fla. — The UK Space Agency has picked Luxembourg-headquartered ClearSpace’s British unit as prime contractor for a 2029 mission aiming to de-orbit two defunct small satellites, the in-orbit servicing venture announced Oct. 15.

global.title: Agile Space Industries Expands to Seattle Area with New Bellevue Office
global.summary: BELLEVUE, Wash., Oct. 15, 2026 — Agile Space Industries, a leading provider of in-space chemical propulsion solutions, has expanded into the Seattle metropolitan area with the opening of a new office in Bellevue, Washington. The expansion builds on Agile’s continued growth, extending its engineering capabilities and strengthening its presence in one of the nation’s most established aerospace and technology markets.
